method: Exploratory gz turning-point pairing: Gaussian sigma=2 samples; prominence>=50 deg/s; signed height>=40 deg/s; same-sign peak distance>=25 samples. Pair each negative extremum with the first qualifying positive extremum before the next negative extremum.
limitations: Early handling or posture changes may be counted.
Slow low-amplitude motions may be missed.
Thresholds are exploratory and are not a validated gesture detector.
The 13.303-15.407 s region contains sensor saturation.
Turning points are not full gesture onset/offset boundaries; no training labels have been created.
